statement.excerpt: This has led to the single-highest inflow of foreign investments into US equities in history — larger than the Dot-Com Bubble, the leadup to the Great Financial Crisis, and even the dying gasps of the Zero Interest Free Era in 2021, per Apollo:

from_speaker: single-highest inflow of foreign investments into US equities in history
the leadup to the Great Financial Crisis
our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is a record flow into US equities, materially driven by foreign demand for AI exposure.
Treat inflow as foreign net purchases, rather than the market value of foreign holdings or total flows into all US assets.
Compare nominal US-dollar flows over identical measurement windows and with consistent coverage.
The claimed record must have occurred by publication. The beginning and aggregation window cannot be recovered from the words alone, so no monthly or trailing-year window is silently imposed.
The claim includes causation; establishing a record flow alone would not establish the whole proposition.
criteria.support_condition: A consistent historical equity-flow series establishes a record by October 20, 2026, exceeding the named episodes, and credible allocation or investor evidence shows that demand for AI exposure materially drove it.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The same flow series and aggregation window show a larger earlier inflow, or credible causal evidence rules out a material AI contribution. A record in holdings rather than flows does not satisfy the claim.
